summary: No product media alt text was written in Shopify because every MediaImage on products already had non-empty alt / image.altText in Admin API.
methodology: GraphQL: products pagination (50/page), media(first: 50) with ... on MediaImage { id alt image { url altText } }. Empty = both alt and image.altText trim to empty string.
note: If an external PDF scan still reports missing alts, causes are often: theme Liquid outputting img without alt, third-party app markup, non-product images (sections), or cached HTML. Content > Files was spot-checked via files query; sample nodes had alt text (often filename-based).
